items.title: Greg Abel Nearly Doubled Berkshire’s Lennar Stake and Added a $689 Million IPO Position
items.summary: Berkshire's first big moves under Greg Abel include a surprise bet on a slumping homebuilder, a fresh IPO and trims to two bank holdings. The filing shows what changed, but the real question is what Abel saw that the market missed.

items.title: Greg Abel Makes His Next Moves: Inside Berkshire’s Q3 Portfolio
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's Q3 13F shows it nearly doubled its Lennar stake to $2.1 billion, added Bending Spoons, and cut VeriSign and Capital One Financial holdings.

items.title: Why Is Capital One (COF) Down 10.8% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: Capital One (COF) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: Mid-market firms’ optimism grows despite economic uncertainty
items.summary: Encouraged by stronger financial performance, companies are planning to ramp up investments — particularly in AI, a Capital One executive said.

items.title: JPMorgan Reveals Cause of Banking Outage That Disrupted U.S. Customers
items.summary: A technical failure disrupted online banking and transfers, with JPMorgan ruling out a cyberattack.

items.title: U.S. Credit Card Delinquencies Rise in October Amid Resilient Spending
items.summary: October card delinquencies and charge-offs rose across JPM, C, BAC and COF, but solid spending and below-year-ago credit losses signal consumer resilience.

items.title: Do Wall Street Analysts Like Capital One Financial Stock?
items.summary: Capital One has significantly underperformed the broader market, despite strong quarterly results, while analysts remain firmly bullish on its long-term prospects.
